tips.title: Define Machine Coordinate System
tips.body: Select a model face, vertex, or edge to define the Machine Coordinate System origin and axes orientation.

tips.title: Set Tool Start Level
tips.body: The Tool start level defines the Z-level at which the tool starts working. Ensure it is not over the limit switch of the machine.

tips.title: Define Stock Model Offsets
tips.body: For the X+, X-, Y+ and Y- offsets, use values of 2. For the Z+ offset, set to 0.25. For the Z- offset, set to 5.

tips.title: Define target model
tips.body: Click on the solid body to choose the target. The solid body is highlighted, and the Solid 1 icon appears in the Selection section.

tips.title: Save CAM-Part data
tips.body: Confirm the Milling Part Data dialog box by clicking OK.

tips.title: Close CAM-Part
tips.body: Right-click the CAM-Part header in the InventorCAM Manager tree and choose Close from the menu.

tips.title: Define machining geometry for Profile Milling
tips.body: A Geometry for Profile, Pocket, Contour 3D, Slot and T-Slot operations consists of a number of chains.

tips.title: Define machining geometry for Pocket Milling
tips.body: A Geometry for Face Milling operations can be defined by selecting solid models, faces or chains of model elements.

tips.title: Define machining geometry for Drilling
tips.body: A Geometry for Drilling and Thread Milling operations consists of one or more points (drilling centers).

tips.title: Define machining geometry for Thread Milling
tips.body: A Geometry for Thread Milling operations consists of one or more points (drilling centers).

tips.title: Define machining geometry for Contour 3D
tips.body: A Geometry for Contour 3D operations consists of a number of chains.

tips.title: Define machining geometry for Face Milling
tips.body: A Geometry for Face Milling operations can be defined by selecting solid models, faces or chains of model elements.

tips.title: Define machining geometry for Slot
tips.body: A Geometry for Slot operations consists of one or more profiles.

tips.title: Define machining geometry for T-Slot
tips.body: A Geometry for T-Slot operations consists of one or more profiles.

tips.title: Define machining geometry for Engraving
tips.body: A Geometry for Engraving operations consists of a number of chains.

tips.title: Define machining geometry for Pocket Recognition
tips.body: Pocket Recognition automatically recognizes pocket features and creates the necessary machining.

tips.title: Define machining geometry for Drill Recognition
tips.body: Drill Recognition automatically recognizes drill features and creates the necessary machining.

tips.title: Define machining geometry for Edge Deburring Recognition
tips.body: Edge Deburring Recognition automatically recognizes chamfer features and creates the necessary machining.

tips.title: Define machining geometry for ToolBox Cycles
tips.body: ToolBox Cycles enables choosing a machining scenario from pre-defined operations.

tips.title: Define machining geometry for Multi-depth Drilling
tips.body: Multi-depth Drilling enables manual control of drilling operations at every depth.

tips.title: Define machining geometry for Translated Surface
tips.body: Translated Surface enables generating a surface by moving a section along a profile geometry.

tips.title: Define Face Milling geometry
tips.body: Face Milling Geometry can be defined based on the actual Updated Stock boundary or by selecting faces, profiles, or using a model.

tips.title: Set default geometry boundary
tips.body: You can set the Geometry to Stock based boundary or Part based boundary as default in the InventorCAM settings.

tips.title: Define Face Milling geometry using Model option
tips.body: This option generates a rectangle located at the XY-plane and surrounding the Target model.

tips.title: Define Face Milling geometry using Faces option
tips.body: This option enables you to define the Face Milling geometry by face selection.

tips.title: Define Face Milling geometry using Profile option
tips.body: This option enables you to define the Face Milling geometry by a profile.

tips.title: Select a tool for Face Milling operation
tips.body: Switch to the Tool page of the Face Milling Operation dialog box and select a suitable tool, such as a face mill.

tips.title: Define tool parameters for Face Milling operation
tips.body: Edit the Diameter, Shoulder diameter, and Arbor diameter to match the selected tool.

tips.title: Define Face depth for Face Milling operation
tips.body: Switch to the Levels page and define the Operation Lower level directly on the solid model.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for Face Milling operation
tips.body: Switch to the Technology page and choose the One Pass option.

tips.title: Modify tool path parameters for One Pass option
tips.body: In the Tool path modifications section, define the angle between the tool path and the geometry.

tips.title: Save and calculate tool path for Face Milling operation
tips.body: Click the Save button to save the operation data and calculate the tool path.

tips.title: Simulate Face Milling operation
tips.body: Click the Simulate button to start a simulation of the machining process.

tips.title: Define Geometry for Profile operation
tips.body: Click the Define button in the Geometry page of the Profile Operation dialog box to select solid model entities for the Geometry definition.

tips.title: Use Smart Face option for geometry selection
tips.body: When the Smart Face check box is selected, it allows you to pick a geometry directly from the face that automatically recognizes all open edges.

tips.title: Use Tangent Propagation for open chains
tips.body: Select entities tangent to the current one or highlight connected entities if no tangent is found.

tips.title: Set Z Deviation for Constant Z Propagation
tips.body: Enter positive and negative Z-deviations in the Delta Z Tolerance edit boxes to identify entities on the same Z-level.

tips.title: Close gaps with Curve + Close Corners
tips.body: Extend entities virtually up to their intersection to close gaps between successive chain entities.

tips.title: Select Loop by Edge
tips.body: Pick an edge shared by two model faces to select a loop, and choose one of the loops to define a closed geometry chain.

tips.title: Define Tool for Profile Milling
tips.body: Select an End mill of Ø16 from the Part Tool Table and set parameters like Diameter, Spin rate, Feed XY, and Feed Z.

tips.title: Set Milling Levels for Profile Operation
tips.body: Define Upper level, Profile depth, and Delta depth using the Pick Upper level and Pick Lower level dialogs.

tips.title: Modify Tool Position for Profile Operation
tips.body: Check the Tool side option in the Modify section to set the tool position relative to the geometry (Right, Left, Center).

tips.title: Set Step down parameter for Profile roughing
tips.body: Step down = 5 mm; last cut at Z-level defined by Profile depth.

tips.title: Define Wall and Floor offsets for Profile roughing
tips.body: Wall offset = 0.5 mm; Floor offset = 0.5 mm.

tips.title: Select Lead in and Lead out strategy
tips.body: Choose 'Arc' for both lead in and lead out; Tangent extension = 5 mm, Radius = 2 mm.

tips.title: Define geometry for Pocket operation
tips.body: Use closed chains defined by solid model edges.

tips.title: Select tool for Pocket operation
tips.body: End mill, Diameter = 8 mm.

tips.title: Define Milling levels for Pocket operation
tips.body: Upper level = 0; Pocket depth = 8 mm; Step down = 4 mm.

tips.title: Set Offsets for Pocket operation
tips.body: Wall offset = 0.2 mm; Floor offset = 0.2 mm.

tips.title: Select Contour strategy for Pocket operation
tips.body: Contour option; Start from 'Inside'; Corner = 'Fillet'; Min. corner radius = default.

tips.title: Define Ramping strategy for Pocket operation
tips.body: Choose 'None' for ramping strategy.

tips.title: Define tool entry method
tips.body: Choose from Vertical, Angle, Helical, or Linear ramping methods.

tips.title: Set tool step down parameters
tips.body: Enter the Tool step down parameter, Angle, and Radius for helical ramping.

tips.title: Use center cutting for tools with capabilities
tips.body: Select the Center cutting check box if your tool has this feature.

tips.title: Define lead in and lead out strategies
tips.body: Choose from None, Normal, Arc, or Tangent for pocket machining.

tips.title: Set lead in parameters
tips.body: For Arc lead in, set Tangent extension to 3 and Radius to 2.

tips.title: Confirm lead out parameters
tips.body: Under Lead out, select the Same as Lead in check box.

tips.title: Calculate tool path for pocket operation
tips.body: Click to save data and calculate the tool path.

tips.title: Simulate pocket operation
tips.body: Simulate the operation in SolidVerify and Host CAD simulation modes.

tips.title: Add drilling operation to pocketing
tips.body: Right-click the last Profile operation and choose Drilling from the Add Milling Operation submenu.

tips.title: Select drill geometry options
tips.body: Choose from Pick position, 3 Points on circumference, Multi-positions, or All circle/arc centers.

tips.title: Define drilling tool parameters
tips.body: Set Spin rate to 1200 and Feed Z to 200 for the Spot drill.

tips.title: Set center drilling depth
tips.body: Choose Depth type as Diameter value and set the value to 5 for a 5 mm tool diameter.

tips.title: Calculate centering depth for drilling
tips.body: Use the formula Centering_depth = Diameter_value / (2 * tan(α/2)) to calculate the centering depth.

tips.title: Simulate operations using SolidVerify
tips.body: Use SolidVerify simulation mode to simulate operations before executing them.

tips.title: Define drilling operation parameters
tips.body: Set Spin rate to 3000 and Feed Z to 360 for the drilling operation.

tips.title: Define drilling depth for through drilling
tips.body: Set Delta value to -5 and choose Full diameter option for through drilling.

tips.title: Use pecking cycle for chip breaking
tips.body: Select Peck option in the Drill cycle type to use pecking for chip breaking.

tips.title: Define step down for pecking
tips.body: Set Step down to 1.5 for defining the depth of each pecking movement.

tips.title: Define stock model for machining
tips.body: Use the Box method to define the stock model with allowances in Z direction.

tips.title: Define coordinate system for machining
tips.body: Pick three points on the solid model to define the Coordinate System.

tips.title: Define target model for machining
tips.body: Select a solid body as the target model in the Target dialog box.

tips.title: Add Face Milling operation
tips.body: Right-click Operations header and choose Face from the Add Milling Operation submenu.

tips.title: Define Face Milling tool parameters
tips.body: Set Shoulder length to 27.5 and Cutting length to 10 for the Face mill.

tips.title: Define Face Milling depth
tips.body: Select the model face to define the Face depth for machining.

tips.title: Use Hatch machining technology
tips.body: Select Hatch option in the Technology section for linear pattern machining.

tips.title: Set hatch angle automatically
tips.body: Choose 'Automatic optimal angle' to let InventorCAM calculate the best hatching angle.

tips.title: Define extension along tool path
tips.body: Set extension along the tool path using either percentage of tool diameter or a specific value.

tips.title: Use fillet for smoother transitions
tips.body: Select 'Fillet' in the Corner section to create smooth transitions between path directions.

tips.title: Define lead-in and lead-out
tips.body: Use the Tangent option in the Lead-in section for a smooth approach to the material.

tips.title: Set finish offset for final machining
tips.body: Select the Finish check box and set the Floor offset to 0.2 in the Offsets section for finishing.

tips.title: Define profile depth for machining
tips.body: Click on the model face to define the Profile depth in the Levels section.

tips.title: Set step down values for roughing and finishing
tips.body: For roughing, set Step down to 3.5; for finishing, set Step down to 7.

tips.title: Use clear offset for additional machining
tips.body: Select the Clear offset check box and set Offset to 5, Step over to 2.5 for additional machining.

tips.title: Define lead-in and lead-out for profile operations
tips.body: In the Lead in section, choose 'Arc' with a Radius value of 12; in the Lead out section, select 'Same as Lead in'.

tips.title: Simulate operations for verification
tips.body: Click the Simulate button to verify distances and dimensions during simulation.

tips.title: Simulate operations before saving
tips.body: Click 'Simulate' to verify toolpaths and avoid errors.

tips.title: Define geometry for multiple features
tips.body: Select all model edges to complete the chain in the Geometry Edit dialog box.

tips.title: Use a specific tool for operations
tips.body: Define an End mill of Ø8 with CAT40 adaptor and BT40 ER32×60 tool holder.

tips.title: Set machining levels for operations
tips.body: Define upper and lower levels in the Milling levels section.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for operations
tips.body: Set step down, wall offset, and finish parameters in the Technological parameters section.

tips.title: Define lead-in and lead-out strategies
tips.body: Set arc radius for lead-in and lead-out in the Lead in and Lead out section.

tips.title: Save and calculate toolpaths
tips.body: Click 'Calculate' to save the operation data and generate toolpaths.

tips.title: Define a new coordinate system for operations
tips.body: Create a new Coordinate System in the CoordSys Manager dialog box.

tips.title: Rotate and reposition the model for new operations
tips.body: Rotate the model and define a new Coordinate System using a planar face.

tips.title: Define geometry for face milling operations
tips.body: Select the Machine Coordinate System #2 and define geometry using the Constant Z Propagation option.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for face milling operations
tips.body: Set hatch angle, overlap, and roughing offset in the Technology section.

tips.title: Define ramping strategy for pocket operations
tips.body: Choose the Helical option in the Ramping section of the Pocket Operation dialog box.

tips.title: Define lead-out for pocket operations
tips.body: Set arc radius for lead-out in the Lead out section of the Pocket Operation dialog box.

tips.title: Save and calculate pocket operation data
tips.body: Click 'Calculate' to save the Pocket operation data and generate toolpaths.

tips.title: Select Tool for Operation
tips.body: Choose the Ø16 End mill for operations.

tips.title: Define Milling Levels
tips.body: Start machining at the Z-level of top faces and end on bottom face of pocket.

tips.title: Set Step Down for Contour Operation
tips.body: Set Step down to 2 in the Technology section.

tips.title: Configure Offsets for Contour Operation
tips.body: Set Wall offset, Island offset, and Floor offset to 0.2.

tips.title: Select Helical Ramping Strategy
tips.body: Choose the Helical option in the Ramping section with a Radius of 3.

tips.title: Set Arc Lead Out
tips.body: Choose the Arc option in the Lead out section with a Radius value of 2.

tips.title: Add New Pocket Operation Template
tips.body: Use the last created Pocket operation as a template for new operations.

tips.title: Define Rest Material Parameters
tips.body: Choose the Rest option to remove material from areas not machined with previous tool.

tips.title: Set Previous Tool Diameter
tips.body: Define the diameter of the end mill used in previous operation and set Extension/Overlap to 1.

tips.title: Simulate Rest Material Operation
tips.body: Play simulation in SolidVerify mode to check machining completeness.

tips.title: Add Profile Operation for Finishing
tips.body: Use the Profile operation for finish machining of pocket walls.

tips.title: Set Equal Step Down for Profile Operation
tips.body: Select the Equal step down check box and set Max step down value to 3.

tips.title: Configure Helical Milling for Profile Operation
tips.body: Set the Depth type to Helical for spiral movements around geometry.

tips.title: Set Normal Lead In and Out for Profile Operation
tips.body: Choose the Normal option with a Normal length value of 5.

tips.title: Simulate Profile Operation
tips.body: Play simulation in SolidVerify mode to check machining completeness.

tips.title: Add Profile Operation for Island Machining
tips.body: Use the Profile operation to machine walls of islands.

tips.title: Set Constant Z Propagation for Island Geometry
tips.body: Choose the Constant Z Propagation option to complete the chain automatically.

tips.title: Define Face Milling Operation for Top Faces
tips.body: Use the Face Milling operation to machine top faces of pads.

tips.title: Set One Pass Strategy for Face Milling
tips.body: Choose the One Pass strategy in the Technology page.

tips.title: Add Pocket Operation for Floor Machining
tips.body: Define a new Pocket operation to finish machining the pocket floor.

tips.title: Set Wall and Island Offsets for Floor Machining
tips.body: Set Wall offset and Island offset to 0.1.

tips.title: Simulate Floor Machining Operation
tips.body: Play simulation in SolidVerify mode to check machining completeness.

tips.title: Simulate operations in SolidVerify mode
tips.body: Play simulations to verify toolpaths and ensure accuracy before executing on the machine.

tips.title: Define geometry for milling operations
tips.body: Choose the correct machine coordinate system and define geometry accurately to ensure proper toolpath generation.

tips.title: Select appropriate tools for operations
tips.body: Choose tools based on the material and operation requirements, such as end mills, spot drills, and taps.

tips.title: Define drilling parameters
tips.body: Set drilling depths, stepdown values, and cycle types to ensure proper hole formation.

tips.title: Simulate drilling operations in SolidVerify mode
tips.body: Play simulations to verify the accuracy and safety of drilling operations before executing on the machine.

tips.title: Define pocketing parameters
tips.body: Set pocket depths, stepdown values, and cycle types to ensure proper material removal.

tips.title: Simulate pocketing operations in SolidVerify mode
tips.body: Play simulations to verify the accuracy and safety of pocketing operations before executing on the machine.

tips.title: Define face milling parameters
tips.body: Set depths, stepdown values, and cycle types to ensure proper material removal.

tips.title: Simulate face milling operations in SolidVerify mode
tips.body: Play simulations to verify the accuracy and safety of face milling operations before executing on the machine.

tips.title: Define profile machining parameters
tips.body: Set depths, stepdown values, and cycle types to ensure proper material removal.

tips.title: Simulate profile machining operations in SolidVerify mode
tips.body: Play simulations to verify the accuracy and safety of profile machining operations before executing on the machine.

tips.title: Define rest material machining parameters
tips.body: Set depths, stepdown values, and cycle types to efficiently remove bulk material.

tips.title: Simulate rest material machining operations in SolidVerify mode
tips.body: Play simulations to verify the accuracy and safety of rest material machining operations before executing on the machine.

tips.title: Define counterboring parameters
tips.body: Set depths, stepdown values, and cycle types to ensure proper hole preparation.

tips.title: Simulate counterboring operations in SolidVerify mode
tips.body: Play simulations to verify the accuracy and safety of counterboring operations before executing on the machine.

tips.title: Define bottom face milling parameters
tips.body: Set depths, stepdown values, and cycle types to ensure proper material removal.

tips.title: Simulate bottom face milling operations in SolidVerify mode
tips.body: Play simulations to verify the accuracy and safety of bottom face milling operations before executing on the machine.

tips.title: Define drilling and tapping parameters
tips.body: Set depths, stepdown values, and cycle types to ensure proper hole preparation.

tips.title: Simulate drilling and tapping operations in SolidVerify mode
tips.body: Play simulations to verify the accuracy and safety of drilling and tapping operations before executing on the machine.

tips.title: Define new coordinate system for bottom face milling
tips.body: Create a new coordinate system with the Z-axis oriented normally to the bottom face for accurate machining.

tips.title: Define CAM-Part and operations for machining
tips.body: Create a CAM-Part, select CNC-controller (gMilling_3x), define Machine Coordinate System, Stock, and Target models.

tips.title: Use appropriate Machine Coordinate System for positioning
tips.body: Select the correct Machine Coordinate System for drilling operations based on the provided illustration.

tips.title: Close chain with a line connecting start and end points
tips.body: When confirming an open chain definition, use the Close Chain dialog box to close the chain with a line connecting the start and end points.

tips.title: Set Wall and Floor offsets for open pocket machining
tips.body: In the Offsets section, set the Wall offset and Floor offset to 0.2 for open pocket machining.

tips.title: Use Profile strategy for open pocket machining
tips.body: Select the Use profile strategy check box to perform open pocket machining in a Profile manner.

tips.title: Approach from outside for open pocket machining
tips.body: Select the Approach from outside check box to enable the tool to approach from outside of the material in open pocket areas.

tips.title: Define geometry chain for Contour 3D operation
tips.body: Define the geometry chain on the upper edge of the hole as shown in the illustration.

tips.title: Add new tool for Contour 3D operation
tips.body: Add a new Ø10 End mill tool for the Contour 3D operation.

tips.title: Set technological parameters for Contour 3D operation
tips.body: In the Offsets section, set the Wall offset value to 0.2 and select the Rough check box with a Step down of 2 for rough machining.

tips.title: Define Lead in and Lead out for Contour 3D operation
tips.body: For Lead in, choose the Arc option with a default Radius value of 2, and for Lead out, select the Same as Lead in check box.

tips.title: Simulate the operation in SolidVerify mode
tips.body: Perform the simulation of the operation in SolidVerify mode to ensure accuracy.

tips.title: Set tool side for Contour Milling
tips.body: Set Tool side to Right in the Technology page.

tips.title: Define geometry for Contour Milling
tips.body: Define the geometry chain on the upper edge of the face as shown.

tips.title: Set step down for Contour Milling
tips.body: Set Step down to 0 in the Technology page.

tips.title: Select Chamfer option for Contour Milling
tips.body: Select the Chamfer check box and switch to the Chamfer tab.

tips.title: Set cutting diameter for Chamfer
tips.body: Set Cutting diameter value to 2.

tips.title: Define geometry for Profile machining
tips.body: Define the geometry as shown.

tips.title: Set step down for Profile machining
tips.body: Set Step down value to 0.1 in the Technology page.

tips.title: Enable Wall draft angle for Profile machining
tips.body: Check the Wall draft angle option and set External wall angle to 8.

tips.title: Define geometry for T-slot machining
tips.body: Define two geometry chains as shown.

tips.title: Set cutting length for Slot Mill
tips.body: Edit the tool parameters and set Cutting length to 3.

tips.title: Define geometry for Drilling operations
tips.body: Define several Drilling operations to perform the machining of countersink holes.

tips.title: Set cutting depth overlap for finishing
tips.body: Set Cutting depth overlap value for finishing to 2.

tips.title: Define geometry for Thread Milling operation
tips.body: Define the geometry by clicking on the internal surface of the part.

tips.title: Select Thread Mill tool for operation
tips.body: Choose the Thread Mill tool for the operation.

tips.title: Edit dimensions for shaped tool
tips.body: Edit the cone and cylinder dimensions as specified.

tips.title: Set default Internal type in Thread Data area
tips.body: Choose Internal type and set Major thread diameter to 64.

tips.title: Define Lead in for Thread Milling
tips.body: Under Link page, select Start from the center and set other parameters.

tips.title: Simulate Thread Milling operation
tips.body: Perform simulation in Host CAD mode and SolidVerify mode.

tips.title: Add Thread Milling operation for external surface
tips.body: Define geometry and select a new Thread mill with specific parameters.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for Engraving
tips.body: Switch to Technology page, choose Left in Tool side list, and select Contour from list.

tips.title: Define Geometry for Engraving
tips.body: Select faces, apply Loops filter, and add internal chains to geometry.

tips.title: Define Tool for Engraving
tips.body: Select an Engraving tool with specific parameters like Tip diameter, Taper angle, Feed XY, Feed Z, and Spin rate.

tips.title: Simulate Engraving operation
tips.body: Perform simulation in SolidVerify mode.

tips.title: Define Milling levels for Engraving
tips.body: Set Engraving depth and define Upper level on part surface.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for Indexial 4-Axis Milling
tips.body: Switch to Technology page, choose Left in Tool side list, and select Contour from list.

tips.title: Define Additional Positions
tips.body: Use the Add button in CoordSys Manager to define additional positions around the Machine Coordinate System.

tips.title: Define Stock Model
tips.body: Switch to the Stock iPart member and define the stock model by picking solid bodies.

tips.title: Define Fixture
tips.body: Add the clamping device model to the CAM-Part assembly and define it as an Associative Fixture.

tips.title: Define Pocket Operation for Rough Machining
tips.body: Choose Coordinate System Position #1 and define the geometry with a Helical Ramping strategy.

tips.title: Define Profile Operation for Finish Machining
tips.body: Choose Coordinate System Position #1 and define the geometry with an Arc strategy.

tips.title: Define a Pocket operation for rough machining
tips.body: Use Coordinate System Position #3 and perform rough machining of highlighted faces.

tips.title: Define a Profile operation for finish machining
tips.body: Use Coordinate System Position #3 and perform finish machining of highlighted faces.

tips.title: Define a Pocket operation for rough and finish machining
tips.body: Use Coordinate System Position #4 to perform rough and finish machining of two connector openings.

tips.title: Define a Drilling operation for center drilling
tips.body: Use Coordinate System Position #1 to perform center drilling of M3 holes with a Ø6 spot drill.

tips.title: Define a Drilling operation for drilling and threading
tips.body: Use Coordinate System Position #2 to perform drilling and threading of M6 holes with a Ø6 spot drill.

tips.title: Define a Chamfer operation for chamfer machining
tips.body: Use Coordinate System Position #1 to perform 0.5 mm chamfer machining with a Ø6 chamfer mill tool.

tips.title: Define a Face Milling operation for face milling
tips.body: Use Machine Coordinate System #1 (Position #1) to machine the shown face with the Hatch strategy.

tips.title: Define a Drilling operation for center drilling, drilling, and threading
tips.body: Use Machine Coordinate System #2 to perform center drilling, drilling, and threading of M6 holes.

tips.title: Define a Face Milling operation to remove the clamping tail
tips.body: Use Machine Coordinate System #2 and perform face milling with the Hatch strategy to remove the clamping tail.

tips.title: Define a Pocket operation for back side machining
tips.body: Use Machine Coordinate System #2 to perform rough and finish machining of pocket faces on the back side.

tips.title: Define a Machine Coordinate System for mounting part
tips.body: Define Machine Coordinate System #1 in the center of the revolution face and rotate it to align X-axis with the revolution axis.

tips.title: Define a Machine Coordinate System for back faces machining
tips.body: Define an additional Machine Coordinate System #2 to machine the back faces of the mounting part.

tips.title: Define a Face Milling operation for mounting part
tips.body: Use Machine Coordinate System #1 to perform face milling with the Hatch strategy.

tips.title: Define a Drilling operation for mounting part
tips.body: Use Machine Coordinate System #2 to perform center drilling, drilling, and threading of M6 holes.

tips.title: Define a Circular Pattern of operations
tips.body: Use the Operation Transformations dialog box to define a circular pattern of operations around the revolution axis.

tips.title: Simulate transformed operations
tips.body: Play the simulation of transformed operations in SolidVerify mode to check for gouges.

tips.title: Define a Machine Coordinate System for 5-Axis Milling
tips.body: For each clamping, define the Machine Coordinate System in the center of the revolution face.

tips.title: Define related positions for Machine Coordinate Systems
tips.body: For each position, define a number of related positions around the Machine CoordSys, considering machine limitations.

tips.title: Define CAM-Part and operations for clamp machining
tips.body: Create a CAM-Part, define CNC-controller (TTC_Hermle_C20_full), Machine Coordinate System, Stock, and Target models.

tips.title: Define Machine Coordinate Systems for indexial 5-axis machining
tips.body: Create Machine Coordinate System #1 with positions 1-5 and Machine Coordinate System #2 with position 1.

tips.title: Define Stock and Target models for machining operations
tips.body: Use the Stock configuration for the CAM-Part assembly as the Stock model, and the Machining configuration as the Target model.

tips.title: Define Face Milling operations for clamp faces
tips.body: Create Face Milling operations with the Hatch strategy on the top, back, and front inclined faces using Machine Coordinate System #1.

tips.title: Define Profile operation for openings
tips.body: Create a Profile operation to machine two openings on the front inclined face using Machine Coordinate System #1.

tips.title: Define Slot machining operations for slot faces
tips.body: Create multiple Slot machining operations to machine the slot faces on the top inclined face using Machine Coordinate System #1.

tips.title: Define Hole machining operations for counterbore holes
tips.body: Create multiple Hole machining operations to machine inclined counterbore holes on the top inclined face using Machine Coordinate System #1.

tips.title: Define Bottom face machining operation
tips.body: Create a Face Milling operation with the Hatch strategy to machine the bottom inclined face using Machine Coordinate System #2.

tips.title: Define ToolBox Cycles for various machining strategies
tips.body: Use the Toolbox dialog box to define different machining strategies such as Spiral Open Slot, Spiral Closed Slot Wide, Additional Zigzag Slot, etc.

tips.title: Define parameters for Spiral Open Slot
tips.body: Set Wall offset to 0.5, % of tool diameter to 80, and select the Wall finish option.

tips.title: Define parameters for Wide Spiral Open Slot
tips.body: Set Wall offset to 1 and select the Wall finish option.

tips.title: Define parameters for Wide Spiral Closed Slot
tips.body: Set Wall offset to 1 and select the Wall finish option.

tips.title: Define parameters for Additional Zigzag Slot
tips.body: Select the closed chain and set the Wall finish option.

tips.title: Define parameters for Simple Slot
tips.body: Set Wall offset to 0 and select the Wall finish option.

tips.title: Define parameters for Open slot machined by rolling
tips.body: Set Step down to 10, Approach distance to 1.25, % of tool diameter to 60.

tips.title: Define parameters for Closed Slot
tips.body: Set the tool diameter equal to the slot width.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Spine Slot strategy.

tips.title: Set Step down for Spine Slot machining
tips.body: Set the Step down to 10.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for Temporary Bridges
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Temporary Bridges strategy.

tips.title: Set Shoulder length for Temporary Bridges
tips.body: Set the Shoulder length to 60.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for Simple Corner machining
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Simple Corner strategy.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for Broaching
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Broaching strategy.

tips.title: Set Width and Depth for Broaching tool
tips.body: Set the Width and Depth to 6.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for Closed slot machined by rolling
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Roll into closed slot strategy.

tips.title: Set Approach distance for Closed slot machined by rolling
tips.body: Set the Approach distance value to 1.25.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for Simple Multi Bosses machining
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Simple Multi Bosses strategy.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for One Side Open Slot machining
tips.body: Under Technology, select the One Side Open Slot strategy.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for Ruled Surface machining
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Ruled strategy.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for O-ring machining
tips.body: Under Technology, select the O-Ring strategy.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for Surface flattening on cylinder
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Flattened surface on cylinder strategy.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for Rib cutting
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Rib cut strategy.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for Surface flattening on corner
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Flattened surface on corner strategy.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for Simple Boss Machining
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Simple Boss strategy.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for Spiral pocket machining
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Spiral pocket strategy.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for Wood cutting
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Wood cutting strategy.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for Cylinder top cutting
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Angled cylinder strategy.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for Thin Wall Machining
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Thin Wall Machining strategy.

tips.title: Simulate the operations
tips.body: Right-click the Operations header and choose Simulate.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for Pocket Recognition
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Pocket Recognition strategy.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for Chamfer Recognition
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Chamfer Recognition strategy.

tips.title: Define a new ToolBox Cycles operation for Drill Recognition
tips.body: Under Technology, select the Drill Recognition strategy.

tips.title: Define tool parameters
tips.body: Set Total length: 130, Outside holder length: 120, Shoulder length: 110, Cutting length: 100 for an End mill of Ø16.

tips.title: Define machining levels
tips.body: Set Upper level by clicking on the upper model face and select Equal step down with Max step down value: 5.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for pocket machining
tips.body: Switch to the Technology page and use default parameters for pocket machining.

tips.title: Define ramping strategy for pocket machining
tips.body: Choose Helical ramping strategy with Radius: 5 in the Link page.

tips.title: Simulate the pocket machining operation
tips.body: Simulate the operation in SolidVerify mode to confirm setup.

tips.title: Define external contour machining tool
tips.body: Use an End mill of Ø20 for external contour machining.

tips.title: Define pocket roughing tool
tips.body: Use the same End mill of Ø20 for pocket roughing.

tips.title: Define pocket rest material machining tool
tips.body: Use an End mill of Ø10 for pocket rest material machining.

tips.title: Define drill recognition tool
tips.body: Add a Spot drill tool of Ø16 with Total length: 70, Outside holder length: 60, Shoulder length: 50.

tips.title: Define drilling levels for each group
tips.body: Edit Milling Levels parameters (Upper Level, Drill Depth, Delta Depth) for each drill instance in the Holes Tree section.

tips.title: Set Upper Level value
tips.body: Enter or pick a value for the Upper Level parameter, which can be applied to a single hole, group of holes, or all holes.

tips.title: Define Depth Type for drilling
tips.body: Choose from options like Cutter Tip, Full Diameter, Auto Chamfer/Spot drill, or Diameter Value to define how the drill reaches the specified depth.

tips.title: Set Chamfer depth value
tips.body: Enter a value of 0.2 for the Chamfer depth when using the Auto Chamfer option to ensure proper chamfering.

tips.title: Sort drill positions using Advanced Sorting
tips.body: Select the Linear tab in the Advanced Sorting dialog box and set the Tolerance value to 5 for linear sorting of drill positions.

tips.title: Add new Drill Recognition operation for Ø6.8 holes
tips.body: Create a new Drill Recognition operation to identify and drill Ø6.8 holes on the model.

tips.title: Set pecking parameters for drilling
tips.body: Under Drill cycle, choose the Peck type and set the Step down value to 2 in the Drill Options dialog box.

tips.title: Set drill cycle type
tips.body: Choose Peck cycle type in Drill cycle settings.

tips.title: Set step down value
tips.body: Set Step down value to 2 in Drill cycle settings.

tips.title: Define hole diameter filter
tips.body: Set the Hole Diameter filter range to 4.2 mm in HR Drill Geometry Selection dialog box.

tips.title: Use Advanced drill sorting
tips.body: Choose the Advanced drill sorting option to determine start positions for drills.

tips.title: Set reamer depth
tips.body: Pick the model face to define the Drill depth value for reaming operations.

tips.title: Define chamfer recognition filters
tips.body: Set the Min. Diameter value to 20 in Circular Pocket diameter filter section for chamfer recognition.

tips.title: Select chamfer geometry mode
tips.body: Under Selection mode, use the default Solid Body option for defining chamfer geometry.

tips.title: Set chamfer depth
tips.body: Define the Chamfer depth by setting the value to 0.5.

tips.title: Set cutting diameter
tips.body: Switch to the Technology page and set the Cutting diameter value to 2 for chamfering.

tips.title: Set safety offset
tips.body: Set the Safety offset value to 2 for open chain geometries.

tips.title: Define link in and out
tips.body: Select the Normal option from Lead in list and set the Normal length to 3 for lead-in. Select the Same as Lead in check box in the Lead out section.
